title: Weighted low-degree omission bound
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a finite set, let $E(S)\ge 0$ for every subset $S\subseteq\alpha$, let $J\subseteq\alpha$, let $k\in\mathbb N$, and let $0\le\rho\le 1$. Then $\rho^k\sum_{\substack{S\subseteq\alpha\\|S|\le k,\ S\nsubseteq J}}E(S)\le\sum_{i\in\alpha\setminus J}\sum_{S\subseteq\alpha,\ i\in S}\rho^{|S|}E(S)$.
